executive_summary: Collection window October 26-November 1, 2027. The Bogota waist-tailoring thread produced one new development this window: ffw.com.br, an independent Brazilian fashion/culture editorial platform, published analysis noting that several designers presenting at Sao Paulo's own resort 2028 program showed a comparable boned-waistband-over-shirting silhouette, independently of Bogota's showcase and without crediting or referencing Inexmoda's coverage directly. This is logged as a distinct signal_id -- a regional echo across two separate Latin American markets, not a repeat citation of the original Bogota event -- since the underlying claim (an independently-arising, parallel silhouette pattern) differs in kind from the retail-buy and social-amplification signals already tracked. No new retail or social movement occurred this window beyond what was logged 2027-10-25; those signal_ids are not carried forward again absent new development. The Margiela raw-edge thread remains closed out as of 2027-10-18. Met Gala 2027, Wales Bonner, and CFDA's Fashion Fund/Awards remain untracked going forward per standing convention.

top_signals.name: Sao Paulo resort 2028 program shows a parallel waist-tailoring silhouette, independent of Bogota, per FFW
top_signals.evidence: ffw.com.br published a resort 2028 program review of Sao Paulo Fashion Week noting that a boned or corseted waistband worn over softer shirting or jersey -- the same garment mechanic Inexmoda documented in Bogota two weeks earlier -- appeared across several unrelated Sao Paulo designers' collections. The piece does not cite Inexmoda's Bogota roundup or the vogue.com follow-up, and does not frame the Sao Paulo designers as responding to or aware of the Bogota showcase; it reads the pattern as its own independent observation about the Sao Paulo program.
top_signals.index_note: Logged as a new signal_id distinct from bogota-waist-tailoring-resort28-institutional, -retail-buy, and -social-amplification: this is FFW's own editorial observation of a second, separately-arising instance of the silhouette at a different market week, not a repeat report on the Bogota event itself. Origin classification is editorial_amplified rather than designer_originated, because the primary claim here is FFW's own cross-collection reading of a pattern, not a single designer's stated intent, and rather than retail_adopted or social_amplified, since no stocking decision or social post is the subject. Because the underlying garment mechanic is identical to the Bogota thread and the two are plausibly related market phenomena, this report treats it as part of the same broader tailoring narrative in prose (executive_summary, archive_tags) without merging the signal_ids -- consistent with how the retail-buy and social-amplification signals were kept distinct from the institutional parent on 2027-10-25.
top_signals.human_editor_note: derive_confidence() adopted as-is (medium): source_corroboration_count=1 from 'editorial' (ffw.com.br), which is in HIGH_RELIABILITY_SECTORS, so the single-source medium exception applies. This is genuinely single-sector, single-source corroboration -- no institutional, retail, or second editorial outlet has corroborated the Sao Paulo observation independently, and FFW's piece is itself the only source for the claim. Medium is held, not upgraded to high: one outlet describing a pattern across several designers within its own coverage is not the same as cross-sector confirmation, and this report does not treat a single editorial outlet's internal breadth (multiple designers) as a substitute for a second independent source.

limitations: This report treats the Sao Paulo observation and the Bogota thread as part of the same broader narrative in prose only; it deliberately does not merge them into one signal_id, since FFW's piece does not itself connect the two events and doing so would overstate what a single editorial source actually claimed.

The Sao Paulo signal rests on one editorial outlet's own cross-designer reading within a single program review; no second outlet, retailer, or institutional source has corroborated it independently as of this window.

No new retail or social development occurred on the Bogota thread this window; the 2027-10-25 retail-buy and social-amplification signals are not carried forward again absent new movement, per standing convention against repeating stale signals to fill a quota.
